title: Aragorn
subtitle: Defender of Free Peoples
text: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Remove an <symbol>elven</symbol> token to make a minion skirmishing Aragorn strength –3. <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Remove a <symbol>dwarven</symbol> token to heal a Dwarf. <keyword>Regroup:</keyword> If Aragorn is mounted, remove a <symbol>rohan</symbol> token to wound a minion twice.
